name: Market / Category Trends

commands.command: node -e "require('./app/functions/src/index.js'); require('./functions/src/index.js'); require('./functions/index.js'); console.log('runtime exports and firebase entry loaded')"
commands.summary: runtime exports and firebase entry loaded

notes: Market trend summaries group by category, brand, and base product using canonical enrichment.
Trend classification covers up, down, flat, and insufficient_data.
Deal density uses the Phase 17.3 good-deal classifier.
The helper and API handlers are read-only over canonical, enrichment, and price data.
